package.name: bonbon_ai_model_registry
package.description: Capability-wide AI model registry, router, license guard, downloader, benchmark runner, health monitor, and dashboard publisher for every BonBon AI capability (LLM, ASR, TTS, VAD/wake-word, object/person detection, gesture, face recognition, face/voice emotion, diarization, RAG). Loads config/models/*.yaml as the single source of truth for which model backs which capability, on which hardware target, under which license. Delegates vision-model runtime selection to the existing bonbon_ai_runtime.RuntimeSelector (hailo/cpu/mock) rather than duplicating it -- this package adds the missing cross-cutting concerns (license tracking, download management, benchmark results, unified dashboard status) that no existing package covers across all capabilities at once. Never downloads a model without checking its license and declared storage cost first; never fabricates model availability.
